Chromosome numbers in certain Indian species ofUtricularia L. (Lentibulariaceae) Chromosome numbers from meiotic studies have been reported for the following species ofUtricularia: U. aurea Lour. (n=21);U. baouleënsis A. Chev. (n=10);U. caerulea L. (n=20);U. inflexa var.stellaris (Linn.f.) P. Taylor (n=21);U. minutissima Vahl (n=8);U. scandens Benj. (n=6, 7); andU. stricticaulis Stapf (n=7). There are two cyto-races inU. scandens.
